Encrypted with Windows DPAPI, so they can only be decrypted on this PC under this Windows account.

Applies immediately to open SSH terminals as well.
배경과 비슷해 안 보이는 글자색(밝은 테마의 흰 글자 등)을 읽을 수: Automatically adjusts text colors too close to the background (e.g. white text on a light theme) so they stay readable
출력 내용은 그대로 두고 화면에 색만 덧입힙니다. 서버가 이미 색을 준: Adds color on screen without changing the output. Text the server already colored and full-screen programs like vim and htop are left alone.
대량 출력이 잦을 때만 켜세요. 끄면 메모리 약 70MB 절약 (앱을: Turn on only if you often get large output. Off saves about 70MB of memory (applies after restarting the app)
처음 접속하는 서버의 호스트키 확인: Confirm host key on first connection
끄면 확인 없이 저장 후 접속. 저장된 키와 다르면(중간자 공격 가능: When off, the key is saved and the connection proceeds without asking. A mismatch with the saved key (possible man-in-the-middle attack) always warns
SSH 접속 시 SFTP 패널 자동 열기: Open SFTP panel automatically on SSH connect
로그인에 성공하면 왼쪽에 원격 파일 목록을 붙인다: After a successful login, shows the remote file list on the left
터미널에서 cd 하면 SFTP 패널도 그 폴더로 (셸이 현재 폴더를: When you cd in the terminal, the SFTP panel follows (if the shell reports its current folder — OSC 7). Otherwise, use the panel's terminal button
SFTP 파일을 더블클릭하면 이 프로그램으로 열고, 저장할 때마다 서버에: Double-clicking an SFTP file opens it in this program, and each save is uploaded to the server automatically. Leave empty to use the Windows default program
Ports used for newly added hosts and servers created by cloud sync. Profiles with their own port in profile settings use that port
Nubis 를 열 때 GitHub · Google · Microsoft: Requires signing in with a GitHub · Google · Microsoft account when Nubis opens. Only allowed accounts can get in. Saved server lists and accounts are encrypted with Windows DPAPI separately from sign-in.
Client Secret (Google 만 — 비워 두면 저장된 값 유지: Client Secret (Google only — leave empty to keep the saved value)
테넌트 (회사·학교 계정은 organizations, 특정 회사만이면 테: Tenant (organizations for work/school accounts, or a tenant ID or domain for a specific organization)
GitHub Organization (이 조직 멤버면 허용 — 선택): GitHub Organization (members of this organization are allowed — optional)
조회 명령(ls, df, systemctl status, Get-*: Only query commands (ls, df, systemctl status, Get-*, etc.) run immediately. Other commands and terminal input go through the approval dialog and are recorded in the audit log
끄면 인증서를 확인할 수 없는 서버(자체 서명)도 경고 없이 바로 접: When off, servers whose certificate can't be verified (self-signed) connect without a warning — applies from the next connection
EIP 등 — 클라우드 호스트는 동기화 때 자동으로 채워짐: EIP, etc. — filled in automatically for cloud hosts during sync
